jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.

As IT SAP Retail Consultant, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior SAP Retail Business Consultant, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

For our client, an international company specialized in the management, maintenance and rental of Ground Support Equipment (GSE) for the aviation industry, we are looking for a experienced motivated Welder / Mechanical Assembler. 

As a Welder / Mechanical Assembler, you will be responsible for carrying out welding and metal fabrication work, as well as repairing mechanical components of non-motorized Ground Support Equipment (GSE). You will ensure that all work is performed safely, efficiently and in accordance with technical specifications and quality standards.

Your Responsibilities 

 

 
• Perform welding work using MIG, TIG, stick (electrode) welding and other welding techniques on GSE equipment. 
 

 
• Repair cracks, reinforce structures and manufacture custom metal components. 
 

 
• Assemble and install mechanical parts and components. 
 

 
• Install, adjust and maintain hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
 

 
• Read and interpret technical drawings and engineering plans. 
 

 
• Carry out inspections and preventive maintenance on welded structures and mechanical components. 
 

 
• Repair and maintain locks, locking mechanisms and other mechanical systems. 
 

 
• Inspect completed work to ensure quality standards are met and provide technical support to colleagues when required. 
 

 
• Properly use and maintain welding equipment, tools and workshop machinery. 
 

 
• Comply with all health, safety and quality procedures. 
 

 
• Record completed work, repairs and material usage accurately. 
 
•  
Work closely with colleagues from the mechanical, electrical and workshop departments to ensure efficient maintenance and repair operations.

 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a welder and/or mechanical assembler, preferably within the aviation, automotive or heavy industrial sector. 
 

 
• You have a solid knowledge of MIG, TIG and stick (electrode) welding techniques. 
 

 
• You have experience with metal fabrication, construction work and mechanical assembly. 
 

 
• You can confidently read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints. 
 

 
• You understand the properties of different materials and their behaviour during welding and repair work. 
 

 
• You are accurate, quality-driven and committed to working safely. 
 

 
• You are a reliable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. 
 

 
• You have a good command of the English language. 
 

 
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence. 
 
•  
A forklift certificate is considered an advantage. 

 
• You are willing to obtain an airport security badge and airport driving permit.

You will be the analytical engine behind our clients' most challenging impurity investigations. You will design and execute highly sensitive mass spectrometry methods to ensure the safety and compliance of pharmaceutical products.
 
 

• Design, develop and validate sensitive and robust analytical methods for trace-level analysis quantification (with a primary focus on nitrosamine and NDSRI’s) using LC-MS/MS and HRMS, in compliance with ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines.  

• Perform complex sample preparation and analysis in diverse pharmaceutical matrices, applying expertise in mass spectrometry (Triple Quadrupole, HRMS), chromatographic separation (UHPLC) and sample preparation.  

• Design robust extraction and sample clean-up strategies (e.g., SPE, liquid-liquid extraction) to overcome severe matrix effects in complex drug products, while strictly preventing artifact generation during analysis. 

• Conduct and support root cause investigations related to impurity formation, focusing on chemical pathways, impurity profiling, and risk assessment across drug substance and drug product development.  

• Deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards. Contribute to method transfer and GMP documentation.  

• Promote innovation by exploring novel analytical approaches and emerging technologies to enhance detection limits and method robustness.  

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• Interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects.
  

• Represent Anabiotec/anacura in internal and external scientific forums and scientific conferences. 
 

• PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry (or a closely) related scientific field) or Master degree with at least 6 years of relevant industry experience.  

• Minimum of 4–6 years of hands-on experience in pharmaceutical R&D or analytical services.  

• Proven experience in LC-MS trace analysis in drug substances, drug products, or excipients is a strong asset.  

• Extensive practical knowledge of mass spectrometry (QqQ and orbitrap) and chromatography.  

• Experience in method development, validation, and transfer under GMP conditions.  

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements (ICH Q2, Q3, FDA/EMA guidance on nitrosamines) and GMP principles.  

• Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) is required for high-quality scientific reporting. 

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Capable of prioritizing tasks across multiple urgent client projects in a dynamic CRO environment.

• Involved in the (bio)-pharmaceutical drug development process of our clients. 

• Responsible for the development of complex LC-MS/MS methods for small molecules, proteins and/or oligonucleotides.  

• Operate & maintain LC-MS/MS and HRMS instrumentation, incl. routine performance checks, calibration and (basic) troubleshooting. You act as a subject matter expert on Mass Spectrometry. 

• Support the introduction, qualification and transfer of new MS technologies and analytical workflows. 

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• You deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards and interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects. 
  
 

• PhD (or Master equivalent by experience) in a scientific field with a strong (technical) focus on mass spectrometry. 

• Extensive hands-on experience with LC-MS operation and troubleshooting on high resolution mass spectrometry platforms (ideally combined triple quad MS platforms) is essential. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work on complex analytical investigations, using a systematic root-cause approach to distinguish LC-, MS-, sample- and method-related issues.  

• Experience with a variety of chromatographic separations (e.g. RP-LC, HILIC) and/or nanoflow liquid chromatography is an additional asset. 

• Capable of working to the highest quality standards required to support development, qualification and validation of LC-MS based methods. 

• Proven ability to work in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Excellent organization and communication skills in English. Knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver – Sea Container Transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

You will transport sea containers on dedicated shuttle and short-haul routes between the major port terminals and various warehouses throughout the Port of Antwerp.

As the majority of your work involves local shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals, you can avoid long motorway traffic jams while keeping your schedule tight, efficient, and predictable.

You will work confidently with the various terminal systems and carefully check all container and seal numbers to ensure everything is correct.

Thanks to flexible departure locations, you can also avoid unnecessary commuting time. In consultation with the planning team, you can start from a strategic location in the port that is most convenient for you.

An average working day is approximately 12 hours. However, if you prefer a better work-life balance, a 4/5 employment arrangement or part-time schedule is absolutely negotiable.

You will join a stable, permanent position with a clear focus on reliable, long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Qualifications: You hold a valid CE driving licence and an up-to-date Code 95 qualification.
    
• Language skills: You speak and understand Dutch or English well enough to communicate smoothly and effectively.
    
• Administration: You ensure the accurate and correct handling of CMR consignment notes and terminal documentation.
    
• Professional attitude: You are a serious, reliable professional who always works in a customer-friendly and presentable manner.

jobs.occupation: Chauffeur at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Chauffeur to join the Executive Office.

Jobomschrijving

The job holder operates safely a fully armored vehicle to transport the Ambassador and Deputy Chief of Mission within the city and the surrounding areas. Reacts defensively in response to potential security threat-related situations. Analyses the daily appointment schedule, ensuring familiarity with both a primary and alternate route to the destination, as well as potential security concerns at destination.

EDUCATION: Completion of secondary school.

EXPERIENCE: 3 years of professional driving.

LANGUAGE: Good working knowledge in English. Good working knowledge in French or Dutch.

DRIVER'S LICENSE C

• After thorough training by an experienced colleague, you will independently perform cutting and bending operations.
• You will calculate flat patterns and program the sheet metal processing machines.
• Using technical drawings, you will learn to independently carry out various metalworking operations such as bending, cutting, deburring, tapping, and other machining processes on workpieces.

• You have an A2 degree in Mechanics or equivalent experience.
• You have knowledge of a guillotine shear, press brake, corner notcher, and punching machine.
• You can read and interpret technical drawings.
• Good spatial insight is essential.
• You work accurately and can work independently after the training period.
• Order, cleanliness, and safety are second nature to you.
• English or Dutch.
